scope: ScreenRecord failed review preparation -> retained source editing -> fresh review -> explicit Save
environment: Isolated Xvfb/private D-Bus; synthetic GStreamer capture; daemon MockBackend; native Tauri/WebKitGTK

reproduction.failure: No return-to-edit button after admission rejection or failed encoding

changes: Allow return to editing from failed/cancelled review and observable pre-publication errors
Join review disposal before reopening editor; cleanup errors keep retry path
Keep source recording, name, crop/trim draft; never automatically publish

native.fault_injection: One-shot error responses at custom-protocol fetch for screen_record_admit and screen_record_prepare; actual capture, admitted review cancellation, successful reprepare and Save use native commands

qualification_limits: Native rejected command responses injected; does not prove all decoder/plugin/transport failures
No real portal/PipeWire source or physical hardware test
No new full workspace or 180-second limit run; change limited to GUI review recovery and acceptance harness

failed_harness_attempt.cause: Attempted override of read-only Tauri invoke did not inject failure; replaced with custom-protocol response interception
